products.description: Formulated with powerful SPF 50, this innovative, light-textured sun serum is like a parasol for your complexion. Alongside SPF 50, which shields your skin from the suns damaging rays, Sun Drops also contains an active complex of cassia extract, vitamin E and beta-glucan, which provide further protection and promote the regeneration of damaged cell structures. Used undiluted or mixed with your chosen face cream, this is the protection your complexion is crying out for.
